chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Ẓihār does not occur except in a case where divorce is applicable.

key_terms.الطَّلَاقِ: divorce, meaning the marital situation in which dissolution is legally applicable
key_terms.الظِّهَارُ: ẓihār, a pre-Islamic form of declaring one’s wife unlawful by comparison
key_terms.مَوْضِعِ: the proper place or legal context

ai.seo_question: When is ẓihār legally valid in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning ẓihār, restricting its validity to cases in which divorce could legally take effect. It clarifies that ẓihār is tied to the same marital framework in which talaq applies.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Ẓihar (a form of divorce by comparison) does not apply except in the context where divorce is applicable."
